units.source_text: 龙助的弟弟真一是千重子的青梅竹马之交，直到高中都是同学。

en.t: Ryusuke's younger brother Shinichi had been Chieko's childhood friend, and they had been classmates all the way through high school.

units.source_text: 他性情温柔，尽管他喜欢千重子，可从不曾像龙助那样说出这种令人窒息的话。

en.t: He was gentle by nature, and although he liked Chieko, he had never said such stifling things the way Ryusuke did.

units.source_text: 所以他们相处得很自然。

en.t: So the two of them got along very naturally.
